requirement: The smart-home controller shall reject any device command whose parameter values fall outside the declared type and range, so that malformed values never alter the stored device configuration.
The booking system must validate the format of every date, time and guest-count field before a reservation is saved, so that malformed entries cannot corrupt stored reservation records.
The banking application shall verify that account numbers and monetary amounts entered in a transfer form conform to the required format and precision before the transaction is recorded.
The banking application shall verify each customer's identity through a registered credential check before granting access to any account session.
The database server must confirm the identity of every connecting client by validating a client-supplied certificate against a trusted issuer before accepting any query.
The database server shall check each incoming record against its schema constraints and checksum, and shall block and flag any write that fails the check or shows signs of deliberate tampering.
The simulation software must verify the consistency of input parameter files before a run begins and shall refuse files that were deliberately crafted to corrupt the model state.
The patient-record system shall validate the accuracy of every submitted clinical entry and shall detect and reject injected or manipulated entries that attempt to bypass those checks.

The banking application's fraud-screening function shall flag a transaction only when its detection rules produce a confirmed match, keeping wrongly flagged legitimate transactions below a defined rate.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll system must ensure that its automated check for duplicate or altered salary records reports discrepancies accurately, with erroneous alerts not exceeding a specified percentage.
The forecasting system shall detect tampered historical sales data with a documented maximum rate of incorrect tampering reports, so that analysts can trust the reported data accuracy.
The simulation software shall require each operator to present a valid digital certificate that is checked against the organisation's trusted authority before a simulation session is opened.
The web browser must validate the certificate chain presented by a website and confirm that the certificate names the requested host before treating the site as the claimed party.
The smart-home controller shall compare a scanned fingerprint with the enrolled templates of registered residents and admit only the matching resident to the control interface.
The electronic purse must compare the cardholder's presented fingerprint with the template stored on the card before authorising any spending operation.
The smart-home controller shall apply a digital signature to each firmware update package so that any modification of the package after signing is detectable before installation.
The electronic purse must attach a cryptographic signature to every balance-load record so that any later change to the amount can be detected.
The banking application shall let a customer digitally sign a loan agreement, and shall invalidate the signature if even one character of the agreement is subsequently altered.
The simulation software shall require a user to supply both a knowledge-based credential and a one-time code from a registered token before authorising a purchase of a licensed module.
The banking application must verify two independent proofs of identity, a memorised secret and a single-use code sent to the customer's enrolled device, before releasing any outgoing payment.
The web browser shall require a user to prove ownership of a sync profile through a verified credential before restoring saved bookmarks and stored logins on a device.

The patient-record system must establish the identity of each clinician through a verified credential check before opening any patient chart, and shall deny entry when the identity cannot be confirmed.
The database server shall continue serving legitimate queries while rejecting injection attempts and brute-force connection floods launched by hostile clients.
The simulation software must detect and block attempts to inject malicious scripts through model files and shall maintain correct operation of running simulations during such attempts.
The patient-record system shall monitor inbound network traffic, identify patterns that deviate from the established baseline such as scanning bursts, and block the offending source.
The booking system must recognise unusual surges of requests from a single origin that suggest automated abuse and throttle or drop that traffic while normal customers continue booking.
The compiler shall compute an MD5 digest of each source file and compare it with the expected value so that a modified source file is detected before compilation proceeds.
The smart-home controller must compare an MD5 digest of the downloaded configuration backup with the published digest, and shall refuse to restore a backup whose digests differ.
The patient-record system shall let an authorised clinician recompute the MD5 hash of an archived medical report and compare it with the hash stored at archiving to reveal any alteration.
